about.p1: Hi, I'm Luis David. I started coding at 17 because I found something few people discover so young: that with code you can improve people's lives. Not just fixing a bug, but seeing an idea of yours become something someone uses every day that makes their life easier.
about.p2: I'm passionate about frontend—where my ideas take shape visually—and backend, where the logic that supports them lives. I'm a Full Stack Developer, so I can see the whole product—from user experience to the architecture that makes it possible.
about.p3: Over time, programming has helped me reach goals I once only imagined: winning competitions, leading real projects, and building platforms real people rely on. Every win confirms I'm on the right path.
about.p4: Today I have over two years of experience shipping real products, with the same drive as day one. My goal is to grow into a strong technical leader who inspires teams and builds solutions that matter.
